name: Com tam
summary: Com tam is broken rice, a Saigon everyday plate, usually with grilled pork, a pork skin cake, egg, and fish sauce. It is a full lunch, not a side.
origin: Southern Vietnam, and the default lunch in Ho Chi Minh City.
howToEat: Order suon (the chop) if you want the standard plate.
The fish sauce is meant to go on the rice. Pickled vegetables come with it.
Lunchtime rooms fill with workers. That is the hour.
seoDescription: What a com tam plate includes and where the dish belongs.
